HEADLINE: We hereby inform you that as per Regulation 30 and 33 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosures Requirements) Regulations, 2015, the Board of Directors of the Company at their board ....
MORE:
We hereby inform you that as per Regulation 30 and 33 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosures Requirements) Regulations, 2015, the Board of Directors of the Company at their board meeting held today i.e., Thursday, 5th November, 2026, has inter-alia, considered and approved the following items: 

1. The Unaudited Financial Results for the Quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026.

2. Limited Review Report issued by M/s. K.C. Mehta & Co., LLP Statutory Auditor of the Company on Unaudited Financial Results for the Quarter and Half Year ended 30th September, 2026.          

The above information will also be hosted on the website of the Company; www.smtgrinders.com. in due course. 

The Board Meeting commenced at 11:20 a.m. and concluded at 12:00 P.m. on the same day.
NEWSSUB: Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of Board Meeting Held On Thursday, 5Th November, 2026.

MORE:
Solitaire Machine Tools Ltdhas informed BSE that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled on 05/11/2026 ,inter alia, to consider and approve Apropos Regulation 29 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we hereby inform that a Meeting of the Board of Directors of the company is scheduled to be held on Thursday, 5th Nuvember, 2026 at 11.00 a.m. at the Registered Office of the Company situated at A-24/25, Krishna Industrial Estate, Near B.I.D.C., Gorwa, Vadodara- 390016, Gujarat, India, inter alia to consider and approve, the Standalone Un-audited Financial Results for the Quarter ended 30th September, 2026.
In continuation of our earlier intimation dated 29th September, 2026 regarding Closure of Trading Window, the Trading Window for dealing in securities of the Company has been already closed from 01st October, 2026 and shall remain closed till 48 hours after the declaration of Un-audited Financial Results of the Company for the quarter ended on 30th September, 2026.
